from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, shutil, subprocess
root=Path.cwd()
out=root/"reports/T0006/review-r1-freeze"
frozen=out/"input-snapshot"
targets=["src/kmesh/logic/proof.py","tests/test_proof.py","README.md","docs/implementation_status.md","docs/handoffs/T0006-proof-verifier.md","docs/decisions.md","reports/T0006/provenance.md","reports/T0006/mutation_set_check.py","reports/T0006/record_check.py"]
hashes={}
for name in targets:
    src=root/name
    dst=frozen/name
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(src,dst)
    hashes[name]=hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert hashes["src/kmesh/logic/proof.py"]=="008bdd3633a5d2327cd711b7c9de7149df86b588632db659a23bf34207963daa"
assert hashes["tests/test_proof.py"]=="857dd21dc6e3d573d8a363d4932e08bbbdabf85a6235356b23b235cf360de32b"
history={}
for task in range(1,7):
    for p in (root/f"reports/T{task:04d}").rglob("*"):
        if not p.is_file() or "pytest-tmp" in p.parts or "__pycache__" in p.parts:
            continue
        if task==6 and any(part.startswith("review-r1") for part in p.parts):
            continue
        history[str(p.relative_to(root))]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
records=[]
for p in sorted((root/"reports/T0006").glob("pi-*/record.json")):
    d=json.loads(p.read_text())
    ok=all(hashlib.sha256((p.parent/f"{s}.txt").read_bytes()).hexdigest()==d[f"{s}_sha256"] for s in ("stdout","stderr"))
    records.append({"run":p.parent.name,"exit_code":d.get("exit_code"),"elapsed_s":d.get("elapsed_s"),"logs_hash_valid":ok,"source_stable":d["before"]["source_sha256"]==d["after"]["source_sha256"],"proof_sha256":d["before"]["source_sha256"]["src/kmesh/logic/proof.py"],"test_sha256":d["before"]["source_sha256"]["tests/test_proof.py"],"started_at_utc":d.get("started_at_utc"),"finished_at_utc":d.get("finished_at_utc"),"argv":d["argv"]})
assert all(r["logs_hash_valid"] and r["source_stable"] for r in records)
planning=json.loads((root/"reports/T0006/planning-final-check.json").read_text())
for name in ("reports/T0006/record_check.py","reports/T0006/.gitignore"):
    assert hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==planning["file_sha256"][name],name
old=[]
for path in subprocess.run(["git","ls-files","src","tests","pyproject.toml"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.splitlines():
    baseline=subprocess.run(["git","show","HEAD:"+path],capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
    assert (root/path).read_bytes()==baseline,path
    old.append(path)
report={"input_sha256":hashes,"history_sha256":history,"pi_records":records,"accepted_tracked_inputs_unchanged":old,"recorder_and_ignore_match_planning":True}
(out/"audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print("PASS frozen input hashes, log hashes, run stability, recorder and tracked baseline inputs")
print("Pi RUN count:",len(records),"Historical files frozen:",len(history),"Tracked inputs unchanged:",len(old))
for r in records:
    print(r["run"],"exit=",r["exit_code"],"elapsed_s=",r["elapsed_s"])
